consequence.statement: No operational consequence: the example Grafana dashboard simply renders MirrorMaker2 metrics with units and chart descriptions; nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, or requires migration.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 improved the MirrorMaker2 example Grafana dashboard to set metric units and include chart descriptions; this is an example-artifact improvement with no operational consequence for operator deployments.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The changed subject is an example Grafana dashboard bundled with the release (an artifact for a third-party tool), which does not correspond to any defined subject family, and the evidence names no file, ConfigMap, or key within it.; applicability: The evidence names only the example dashboard and gives no file path, ConfigMap, Helm value, or deployment mechanism through which an environment consumes it, so no static exposure condition can be written.
